feeds.title: Lathe Matters
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Charles Wilson, A DIY enthusiast. I was born and raised in Danville, Illinois. Lathe Matters is the place where I talk about different woodturning projects, products, and ideas.

feeds.title: The English Woodworker Blog
feeds.description: The English Woodworker offers hand tool woodworking education online. Learn through detailed & entertaining woodworking videos, on hand tool set up, techniques, joinery, hand planing and more. We cover the basics right through to mastering your skills with hand tools.

feeds.title: Hand Tool Woodworking Blog
feeds.description: Using traditional tools and techniques, Elia Bizzarri rives hews, shaves, and turns elegant Windsor chairs in his workshop. Known for the quality and elegance of his turning technique, his chairs reflect an integral understanding of the intrinsic qualities of maple, poplar, hickory, and oak.

feeds.title: The Renaissance Woodworker
feeds.description: The Renaissance Woodworker is a woodworking education with a focus on hand tool only construction techniques. A woodworking blog and podcast where author Shannon Rogers shares what is happening in his shop. He loves to work with hand tools and period styles of furniture.
